cohort: The cohort consisted of 24,079 singleton pregnant women with normal thyroid function who underwent routine prenatal examinations at a tertiary hospital in Shanghai between January 2013 and December 2016.
finding: Preeclampsia, cesarean section, advanced maternal age, and preterm birth were found to be strongly associated with elevated neonatal TSH levels after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with elevated neonatal TSH levels.
